welcome_sub: Finish a few steps to start building cyber range scenarios.

banner.title: Finish setting up Range42
banner.body: Add a Git source and a backend-api host to start deploying. You can keep building in the meantime.

add_source.title: Add a Git source
add_source.desc: Register a GitHub, GitLab, or Gitea instance so Range42 can load catalog entries.

add_backend.title: Add a backend-api host
add_backend.desc: Register a backend-api host (its URL plus the Proxmox node it targets) so Range42 can deploy your scenarios.

browse_catalog.title: Browse the catalog
browse_catalog.desc: Pick a scenario, component, or lab to start a new project.
